text: {"lessons":["My account grew 10.5% from Period 1 to Period 5, but five periods are too few to conclude that my approach will keep working.","Buying the same number of shares of every stock led me to spend more on higher-priced stocks; I should think in terms of portfolio weights and diversification.","My recent purchases were at higher prices than my initial ones. I should make each buy or sell decision based on current information and my long-term apartment goal, not just recent price moves."]}
